integrity: The four-support classification, integral cocycle pairings, automorphism order, support orbits, and induced H2 signs are exhaustively checked from the exact facet presentation. The rank-one integral H2 identification is independently supplied by the published topology and Sage homology data.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to Kühnel's nine-vertex triangulation and to vertex-support size for integral simplicial 2-cycles. It does not address geometric area, longer support spectra, or other triangulations of the same manifold.
title: All missing tetrahedra are primitive shortest \(H_2\)-carriers in Kühnel's nine-vertex \(\mathbb{CP}^2\)
